title: FTM person research record
description: One file per person, written to research/<slug>.json. Matches the id and slug of window.RESEARCH.people so it can be merged without reshaping.

entity_group.description: Set when several people share the same company (walmart, koch, mars, msc, chanel). Company-level findings must then be identical across the group.

queries.description: Every search query actually run, for audit.

id.description: Local id, unique within this file. The merge prefixes it with the entity_group if set, otherwise the slug, and reuses an existing key when the URL is already in the dataset.

label.description: Format used by the site: 'Publisher: short title (year)', e.g. 'SEC: Dell and Michael Dell settle disclosure charges (2010)'.

names_subject.description: True only if the document itself names this person or their company. Generic reports about billionaires are false.

level.description: Who the source is about. A company finding must never be written as a personal act.

entity.description: The person, company or foundation the finding concerns.

claim.description: Own words, at most two sentences, no quote longer than 15 words.

proposal.description: A suggestion only. The site's colour is computed from the five score values, so the merge never changes a value: it applies basis and reason only where the proposed value equals the current one. Every value change goes to REVIEW.md for a human decision.

scores.description: Only the dimensions this research has something to say about. Omitted dimensions stay as they are. Scale for each level: window.FTM_DATA.dimensions.

counterweights.description: Replacement for the site's counterweights field ('On the other side'). Must rest on counterweight findings. Empty string keeps the current text.

rationale.description: For the reviewer: why each proposed value, especially where it differs from the current one.

basis.description: documented only when the cited findings support this level of the rubric.

reason.description: Replacement for the site's reason text, same register: what is established and what is not, company acts kept at company level.

finding_ids.description: Findings this score rests on. Non-empty when documented, empty when estimate.

passed.description: True once every remaining finding is 'supported'.
